rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a person who creates art, including visual art.

example.english: That artist recently opened an exhibition in Central.
example.traditional: 嗰位藝術家最近喺中環開咗個畫展。
example.jyutping: go2 wai2 ngai6 seot6 gaa1 zeoi3 gan6 hai2 zung1 waan4 hoi1 zo2 go3 waa6 zin2

rows.note: Use this for a recording artist who performs as a singer rather than for a visual artist.

example.english: This recording artist has just released a new song.
example.traditional: 呢位歌手啱啱出咗首新歌。
example.jyutping: ni1 wai2 go1 sau2 ngaam1 ngaam1 ceot1 zo2 sau2 san1 go1
